description: Save an answer to reuse: a name, an optional subject and a plain-text message. Merge fields such as {{ first_name }} are filled in for each draft's recipient when it is put in. Names are unique in the workspace, case ignored: a taken one answers 409. A workspace keeps up to 100. A merge field that doesn't parse answers 400 with its line and column.

body.description: The message, as plain text, up to 5000 characters. Merge fields such as {{ first_name }} or {{ company }} are filled in for each recipient, the way a campaign step's are; one a recipient has no value for stays as written.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name.description: What you find it by. Unique in the workspace, case ignored.

subject.description: The subject a new message takes when you put this in it. A reply keeps its own. An empty one sets none.

name: create_saved_reply
title: Save a reply
